title: Three-Well Shallow Ceramic Dish
description: One original static shallow ceramic serving dish from the ceramics shallow-plate plan, not a rescaled single-cavity mixing bowl. One connected closed solid includes a full planar bottom, continuous outer wall and annular rim, central hub and three full-depth radial material dividers. These form three genuine separate 110-degree shallow blind wells with their own integral floors and inner walls; no independent bowls, pasted dark patches, overlapping surfaces or loose divider bars. 0.38 m diameter, 0.035 m height, 0.009 m bottom, three 10-degree solid divider sectors. One editable mesh, one constant opaque celadon PBR, metres and ground-centred origin. Static game exterior only; no food-contact, thermal, liquid, load, manufacture or safety certification.
